crises.label: 2008 crash
crises.note: Lehman and the global crash: NIFTY fell about 40% over the window, VIX above 50.

crises.label: Election result 2009 (+17% day)
crises.note: 18 May 2009: upper circuit twice, NIFTY closed about 17% higher; a call-side gap.

crises.label: Demonetisation 2016
crises.note: 9 Nov 2016: demonetisation and the US election together; a gap down then recovery.

crises.label: COVID crash, Mar 2020
crises.note: NIFTY fell about 38% in five weeks, VIX above 80, several 5-13% days.

crises.label: Jun 2022 sell-off
crises.note: Rate-hike sell-off: a grinding fall with VIX in the 20s, the regime a seller meets most often.

crises.label: Election result 2024 (-6% day)
crises.note: 4 Jun 2024: NIFTY fell about 6% on the count, then recovered within days.

crises.label: Synthetic 8% overnight gap
crises.note: The last year of real NIFTY with an 8% overnight gap down inserted and VIX doubled (decaying), worse than any single NIFTY gap since 2008 apart from 2020; every entry timing is tested.
